    public static Microsoft.AspNetCore.Routing.IEndpointRouteBuilder MapPragmaticEndpoints(this Microsoft.AspNetCore.Routing.IEndpointRouteBuilder endpoints)
    {

        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(pragmaticOptions.DefaultAuthorizationPolicy))
                root.RequireAuthorization(pragmaticOptions.DefaultAuthorizationPolicy);
            else
                root.RequireAuthorization();

        return endpoints;
    }

    {

        /// <summary>Route template for ListUsers.</summary>
        public const string ListUsersTemplate = "/users";
        
        /// <summary>Builds the ListUsers URL from typed parameters.</summary>
        public static string ListUsers(string query, int? page = null, int? pageSize = null, string? sortBy = null)
        {
            var __url = $"/users";
            var __query = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();
            __query.Add("query=" + __Fmt(query));
            if (page is not null) __query.Add("page=" + __Fmt(page));
            if (pageSize is not null) __query.Add("pageSize=" + __Fmt(pageSize));
            if (sortBy is not null) __query.Add("sortBy=" + __Fmt(sortBy));
            return __query.Count > 0 ? __url + "?" + string.Join("&", __query) : __url;
        }
    }
    
    /// <summary>Invariant-culture, URL-escaped value formatting for route/query values.</summary>
    private static string __Fmt<T>(T value)
        => System.Uri.EscapeDataString(string.Format(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}", value));
